fact: The 2019-2020 yearbook states that primary-school data come from the annual Censo Escolar questionnaire sent by each school via district inspectorates, processed in the national SIME (school information and map system), run independently by national staff since FHI360 technical assistance ended; it describes aggregate school-level statistics, not learner-level records.
title: Anuario Estadístico de la Educación Infantil y Preescolar, Primaria, Secundaria y Formación Técnica Profesional, Curso Escolar 2019-2020
publisher: Ministerio de Educación, Enseñanza Universitaria y Deportes / PRODEGE
